summary: No searches could be run for the DRC: the session's 200-search budget was used up before this country's first query, so this finding records repo evidence only and is tiered D. The repo already fills all 26 provinces (admin1) for religion and ethnicity from the INS Enquete 1-2-3 survey via the U.S. Census Bureau's HDX workbook -- a sample of 31,755 household heads pooled across 2005 and 2012, not a count -- and that workbook has no language sheet, so language at admin1 and everything at admin2 (189 shapes) is empty. Whether any census has ever tabulated these fields subnationally (prior knowledge says the last census was 1984; unverified here) and whether the 2023-24 DHS offers a newer religion-by-province estimate are the two questions a re-run should settle first.
